plan.title: The next step at the wrap-up: proposed fully defined, adjusted by the tester, then set

context.text: Starts in 10, Riley! 2 min jog, 1 min walk, 3 rounds around the block at 7.

transcript.text: [voice: Done, three rounds of two minutes jogging and one minute walking, about a mile and a half.]
LFG Riley!! Day 4 in the books, and that's your first day with 2-minute jogs in all three rounds 🔥 How did those jogs feel today compared to yesterday, when you said they felt long?
[voice: That was way better than yesterday. I slowed the jogs right down and could actually talk, the second round was easy.]
That's the whole trick, Riley: slow enough to talk, and the second round got easy. What made you try slowing down? Was it something you figured out mid-jog?
yeah I could probably do another round

Then let's use that, Riley. Tomorrow at 7 pm: 2 min jog, 1 min walk, 4 rounds around the block, with the jogs slow enough to talk. That's about 20 min, and a voice note after like today. Work for you?
can we do it at the park instead of my block? it's flatter

Flatter is a smart reason, Riley, and it'll be easier on your legs for a fourth round. Tomorrow at 7 pm at the park: 2 min jog, 1 min walk, 4 rounds, with the jogs slow enough to talk. That's about 20 min, and you'll send a voice note after like today. Good to go?
Locked in, Riley. Tomorrow at 7 pm: park, four rounds, jogs slow enough to talk. Talk to you then 💪
